title: Website Refresh

bodyMarkdown:
## Highlights

- Improved navigation and button layout on smaller screens
- Made Privacy Policy and Terms pages more consistent
- Added a dedicated What's New page

## Why this matters

Website Refresh is one of those tidy-up releases that does not need a parade, but it still helps the site feel less fussy. Small fixes matter here because CogniFocus is supposed to get out of your way fast. Tap in, start the thing, dodge the scroll spiral, continue your tiny heroic quest. That is the whole deal.

- Improved navigation and button layout on smaller screens gets a little more room to breathe.
- Made Privacy Policy and Terms pages more consistent gets a little more room to breathe.
- Added a dedicated What's New page gets a little more room to breathe.

So yes, this is a smaller note. The point is still real: fewer weird little moments, clearer feedback, and less friction between you and the session you meant to start. The Goblin may still be dramatic about it, obviously, but the app should feel calmer where it counts.
